items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But, it is kind of hard to believe that anybody could be more of a perfectionist than Danny.

ctx.x: He did “Saint James Infirmary” with him. But, he was, and away, he was like Benny. He was a perfectionist, maybe more so than Benny. But, it is kind of hard to believe that anybody could be more of a perfectionist than Danny. But, Artie might have been. I think I was on a bona fide record it with Benny. But I don't think he would've done 18 or 15 takes on any tenant. If they got to that point, I think he would've just thrown it in the wastebasket and said, "Let's do something else." Artie had more efficiency than…
Do you think that the ambience of a place like The Embers influence the repertoire? Did that music, as you describe it, sort of, fit into your atmosphere?
